The hybrid cost is light on a three-colour base, though the card does nothing about opponents and dies to sweepers like any creature.

rule_claims.basis: Card text; the ruling that the ability checks as the end step starts.

rule_claims.quote: If none did, the ability won't trigger at all.
rule_claims.interaction: A turn with no creature entering
rule_claims.claim: On a turn without another creature entering under your control, the surveil does not happen.
